description: Deletes an uploaded CSV file or workbook. Reports built on it keep what they last showed, and their datasheets fail on the next read. Only the user who created it may.

idempotencyKey.description: A unique value, such as a UUID, that makes retrying this call safe. A retry with the same key within 24 hours answers the first call's result instead of running it again. Use a new key for each new call. From 1 to 255 printable ASCII characters.

params.description: The ids of what the tool acts on

id.description: The uploaded file to replace or delete: the `id` returned by `createDataset`. Only the user who uploaded the file can replace or delete it; for anyone else, the request fails with a `404`, as if the file did not exist.

name: deleteDataset
title: Delete an uploaded file
